name: Yuuki Airi
source:
A first-year student at Seishin Academy. She is a studious and serious girl. She entered the school with top grades and had hoped to join the student council, but for some reason she was appointed as an “assistant” to the [url=/c133970]sex instructor[/url].

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page05.html]official site[/url]]
